section_summary.extract_value: The introduction defines body image and gender ideology, then introduces the Femininity Ideology Scale (FIS). The present study aims to investigate the associations between FIS factors and body appreciation, a positive body image construct, noting that this relationship has not been previously explored. Table 1 provides descriptive statistics and inter-item correlations for the variables in the study, including body appreciation, FIS factors, age, and BMI, for a sample of N=135.
